shipReasons: No critical defect and no regression at critical or major severity is established: Chapters I, IV, VIII, XII and XVII play at or near live release 74 on the same harness; the only unknown is a single noisy XII swap jerk, a major, which is disclosed, not a hold.

Both hidden chapters render their new paintings and decals with 0 console errors and 0 404s at 1600x900, 2000x1012 and 390x844; the approved-art, art-derive and test gates pass on the exact candidate.

Changed area is UNVERIFIED: 14 of the 19 chapters and the 3D chapters were not run on the candidate (named in coverage), so changedArea cannot be PASS; this is better than live and the deep review is owed on the live build.

checks.reason: The Keeper and Maesters battle HUDs (1600x900, 2000x1012, 390x844) read player words: Glyph 5, Spectral Keeper, Aranea, Berserk, intent ranges low first (1,023 to 1,157). No raw ids seen in the frames read.
The targeting tile was not captured against its target frame in this pass (no change to the targeting code in the diff; the Keeper Move target cursor was seen on Glyph 5).

The two new paintings (Keeper, Aranea, Black Elemental) read at gameplay size beside the cast; the Keeper overlaps Auron on the stage (composition, polish). Approved art unchanged: verify-approved ROOT=release55 953 ok, 0 mismatched, 0 missing.

Real Playwright keys (Enter, Enter) from the first menu through turns to the results screen and Retry, in both hidden chapters; touch tap not exercised (390x844 menu shot only, no horizontal overflow). The chapter was entered through gotoChapter (set-up only) and the end of the fight was handed to autoBattle (set-up only).
Every capture asserted screen === battle (waitBattleMenu) before the shot; the continuity harness asserts its own states.

dist-gate served on 5871 names index-CrrbwEak.js (the expected bundle); art-derive verify PASS (5438 masters, 0 problems), audit PASS (0 dangling), verify-approved 953 ok / 0 / 0 against the release tree; 0 console errors and 0 404s in all browser jobs. Cold-load timing and the deploy-time hash gate were not re-run here (the deploy script owns the file-by-file gate).
tsc --noEmit clean; 23 changed or new vitest files (460 tests) pass on the candidate tree; orphans: 24 pre-existing modules, none named by this change.

Parity: the glyph decal plumbing is shared; the intent-range printer fix is shared (both games); Mix row, Maesters art and tips are FFX-2 only; Keeper platforms and the script-picker branch rule are FFX only.

FFX only: Spectral Keeper art, platformOccupancy, simulate.ts raw 31-bit picker branch (the FFX script picker; FFX-2 has no such draw), Chapter XII intent cause. FFX-2 only: Fallen Maesters art, Mix row hidden. Presence checked in the intended game: Keeper rows (Move, Attack, Special, White Magic, Items, Flee) in FFX; the Maesters menu shows Attack, Item, Change with no Mix row in FFX-2; Chapter XII (FFX) still lists Attack, Special, White Magic, Items, Flee, Escape. The Mix absence in every FFX-2 menu is proved by tests/unit/ffx2-mix-row-hidden.test.ts (passes). Absence of the Keeper decals in the other game: the decal needs the chapter scene, not exercised in an FFX-2 battle by this critic.

Both hidden chapters reach the results screen (Defeat under the engine auto-strategy) and Retry returns to a battle. The win path of the two hidden chapters was not reached in this review (the lane evidence covers it).

Harness on the candidate (normal speed, GPU headless, ?coach=off): Chapter I FAIL (2 swaps over the head tolerance, worst 10.8 percent, 1 height band; live release 74 reads the same, 10.8 / 9.4), IV PASS, VIII PASS, XII PASS, XVII PASS. Chapters II, III, VI, VII, IX to XI, XIII to XVI, XVIII, XIX and the live-comparison of every chapter were not run (about 3 hours at normal speed; named below). Keeper chapter: UNVERIFIED in the lane run (49.8 s of battle, needs 60); Maesters: PASS in the lane run.

Chapter I PASS, IV PASS, VIII PASS. Chapter XII FAIL: 1 swap jerk of 206 px, in a long frame (swapJerksSteadyOverFail 0) while the GPU art batch shared the machine; release 74 read PASS on the same chapter (0 over); a live re-run on echoesofspira.com played 0 swaps and settles nothing. Chapter XVII FAIL: 11 swap jerks, worst 171.9 px (live release 74: 13, 172.5): the same defect, not a regression. Maesters (lane evidence on another tree): 2 jerks at a swap, worst 67 px, in a new feature.
Audio routing and music were not changed in this release.
No audio change in this release.
The prep tip band (Maesters short tip) was read from the unit tests (fallen-maesters-prep-tip, prep-tip-band pass) and not captured in a browser prep screen.
No save or settings change in this release (the plan does not class it as save-data).
The three 3D chapters (fayth, yrp, waker) were not opened by this critic; the teardown is read from the lane (YR-11 textures flat, HIT) and the retry-leak unit tests, which pass.
Not captured by this critic.
No portrait or menu pose rule changed.
The glyph decal plumbing and the physical-moves-on-idle table were reached through the real presentation path: the Keeper glyphs are painted on the stage in the first menu frame.
